claims: Monte Carlo is an administrative area in the Principality of Monaco on the French Riviera.
Monte Carlo was established in 1866 by Prince Charles III.
Monte Carlo is officially a ward (Monte Carlo/Spélugues) and a surrounding quarter.
Monte Carlo hosts the Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters tennis tournament.
Monte Carlo hosts the Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix.
Monte Carlo is situated on an escarpment at the base of the Maritime Alps along the Mediterranean Sea.
Monte Carlo Casino was built in 1861.
Monte Carlo Casino has gambling rooms exclusively for visitors.
Monte Carlo features the Hôtel de Paris.
Monte Carlo features the Café de Paris.
Monte Carlo features the Opéra de Monte-Carlo.
The Opéra de Monte-Carlo was designed by Charles Garnier in 1878.
Monte Carlo includes manicured terraces near the casino.
Monte Carlo includes the Japanese Garden.
Monte Carlo is home to the Monte Carlo Masters.
The Monte Carlo Masters is a clay-court ATP tennis tournament.
Monte Carlo was developed to save Monaco's economy.
Prince Charles III granted a charter for a casino.
Prince Charles III named the area "Monte-Carlo" in 1866.
A 2011 movie named Monte Carlo was filmed partly in Monaco.
The Chevrolet Monte Carlo was a personal luxury car model by General Motors
The Chevrolet Monte Carlo was named to evoke the atmosphere of luxury of Monte Carlo.
